name: Safe Browsing (Unsafe Sites)
description: Malware and phishing sites detected weekly by Google Safe Browsing. Weekly unsafe-site counts and detection trends.

data.summary: Weekly counts of malware and phishing sites detected by Google Safe Browsing.
key_facts: Phishing sites now outnumber malware sites roughly 10:1.
Detected unsafe sites peaked around 2016-2017; declined with browser warnings.
Safe Browsing protects 5B+ devices across Chrome, Android, Firefox.
